oos_clock_reset_note: Operator-recorded 2026-11-16 (selector-only order authorized 2026-11-13; supersedes the 2026-11-12 start). The clock starts with the first promoted production run on the selector-only code, 2026-11-16 (run manifest commit ae5ceb81); the 2026-11-13 runs failed promotion on the drift gate and took no capture. Starting configuration includes the PIT cash/securities fix (PR #682) and the de_vol_60d refresh (PR #676), both merged before the run. model_hash unchanged (ast-v2). Captures dated before oos_clock_start do not count toward SM-20260629-001; the mandate restarts at 0/20. See docs/governance/2026-11-13-selector-only-production-switch.md and docs/governance/2026-11-16-selector-only-clock-start.md.
